Cowboy is part of 4 of my public repositories, from 2019 to 2025.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (4).

Most recently: [job-processor](@/work/job-processor.md): This is a simple web service built with Elixir, Plug, and Cowboy that processes job tasks with dependencies and generates execution order and bash scripts; [el-magico-cache](@/work/el-magico-cache.md): Elixir Cache; [kanec](@/work/kanec.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Cowboy: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Cowboy to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
